pre_cleared_threads.target_query: Square to GnuCash import CSV split fees
pre_cleared_threads.verbatim_template: Built a small open-source, client-side utility to solve this exact problem: it converts Square Transactions.csv and Transfers.csv into balanced GnuCash multi-split CSVs (handling fees, sales taxes, tips, and clearing deposits). 100% in-browser, zero server uploads, MIT licensed: https://4ourenterprises.me/square-to-gnucash/ (source: https://github.com/4ourCEo/square-to-gnucash)

pre_cleared_threads.target_query: reconciling Square POS processing fees and gross sales
pre_cleared_threads.verbatim_template: If you're still looking for an automated way to prepare Square exports for the GnuCash CSV Import Assistant, I created a free, zero-upload tool that parses Square transaction/settlement files into balanced multi-split journal entries: https://4ourenterprises.me/square-to-gnucash/ (open-source MIT, runs locally in browser memory).
